test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

The rhime and rhythm of Papai’s poems are highly symbolical and timely.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Rhime**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be "Rhyme"
 
• Rhyme: Correspondence of sound between words or the endings of words, especially when these are used at the ends of lines of poetry. (शब्दों या शब्दों के अंत के बीच ध्वनि का पत्राचार, खासकर जब इनका उपयोग कविता की पंक्तियों के अंत में किया जाता है)
 
 
• For example- *She used “moon” as a rhyme for “June.”*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1, which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Timely**: Done or occurring at a favourable or useful time; opportune. (अनुकूल या उपयोगी समय पर किया या घटित होना; उपयुक्त)
 
• **Rhythm**: A strong, regular repeated pattern of movement or sound. (ध्वनि का एक मजबूत, नियमित दोहराया पैटर्न)
 
• **Symbolical**: Relating to or using or proceeding by means of symbols. (प्रतीकों के माध्यम से संबंधित या उपयोग या आगे बढ़ना)

32:Tea6,

The incorrectly spelt word is: **Judege**.
